question: Two identical bar magnets are placed with their centers at a distance $d$ apart. In Case 1, their north poles face each other. In Case 2, the north pole of one faces the south pole of the other. How does the potential energy of the system compare in these two cases?

options.A: Potential energy is lower in Case 1 than in Case 2.
options.B: Potential energy is lower in Case 2 than in Case 1.
options.C: Potential energy is zero in both cases.
options.D: Potential energy is positive in both cases.
